descriptionText: GitHub Actions workflows using actions/checkout without persist-credentials: false may leak credentials through artifacts. By default, actions/checkout persists the GITHUB_TOKEN in the local git config, which can then be included in artifacts if the entire workspace is uploaded. Starting with actions/checkout@v6, credentials are stored in a temporary location reducing (but not eliminating) the risk. This rule detects checkouts without persist-credentials: false, especially when followed by actions/upload-artifact with dangerous paths like '.' or github.workspace.
